Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 23

“Let me see those who have gathered here to fight, intending to please the evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra in this war.”

Arjuna already names Duryodhana as 'evil-minded' — his moral judgment of the cause is formed before he even looks upon the army. What follows will complicate that judgment considerably.
